note: Curated list of museums and galleries you can visit any time, independent of the event feed. Check each site for opening hours and current exhibitions.

places.name: Zeitz MOCAA
places.blurb: Africa's largest museum of contemporary African art, in the converted grain silo at the Waterfront.

places.name: Norval Foundation
places.blurb: Modern and contemporary South African art with a sculpture garden, restaurant and wetland walk.

places.name: Iziko South African National Gallery
places.blurb: The national art collection: historical and contemporary South African, African and European works.

places.name: Irma Stern Museum
places.blurb: The artist's former home, kept with her studio, collections and a programme of changing exhibitions.

places.name: District Six Museum
places.blurb: Memory museum of the neighbourhood destroyed under apartheid, with tours by former residents.

places.name: Iziko Slave Lodge
places.blurb: One of the oldest buildings in Cape Town, telling the history of slavery at the Cape.

places.name: Rupert Museum
places.blurb: 20th-century South African art from the Rupert collection, with changing exhibitions.

places.name: Goodman Gallery
places.blurb: Long-running contemporary gallery representing major South African and international artists.

places.name: Stevenson
places.blurb: Contemporary gallery with a strong programme of African and diaspora artists.

places.name: SMAC Gallery
places.blurb: Contemporary South African art, with a second space in Stellenbosch.

places.name: WHATIFTHEWORLD
places.blurb: Contemporary gallery known for emerging and mid-career South African artists.

places.name: Everard Read Cape Town
places.blurb: Established gallery for contemporary painting and sculpture, beside CIRCA.

places.name: Southern Guild
places.blurb: Collectible design and contemporary art from Africa.

places.name: A4 Arts Foundation
places.blurb: Non-profit arts space with exhibitions, a library and public programmes.

places.name: First Thursdays
places.blurb: On the first Thursday of each month galleries and shops in the city centre stay open late.
